This is not a workaround or a series of makeshift solutions cobbled together to bypass restrictions. This is a base-layer infrastructure designed to give digital creators sovereignty over their own commerce stacks. By using Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments, creators can build, deploy, and scale their own digital commerce solutions, without relying on platforms that may be restricted or unavailable in their region.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments provides automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, with a 0.5% fee. The combination of these components enables creators to build a fully functional digital commerce stack, complete with automatic payment processing and instant product delivery.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is built for digital creators in regions where access to platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad is restricted or unavailable. This includes countries like Venezuela, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines, where cryptocurrency adoption is on the rise and digital commerce is becoming increasingly important. By providing a sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, creators can monetize their digital products and reach a wider audience, without being tied to a particular platform or region.

With this knowledge and these tools, creators can deploy a fully functional digital commerce stack in a matter of hours, without relying on platforms that may be restricted or unavailable in their region.

Global access through sovereign infrastructure works because every layer of the stack is geography-neutral by design. Cloudflare Pages serves your storefront from data centers close to your buyer — whether they are in London or Lagos, the page loads in under 200 milliseconds. NOWPayments generates a unique payment address for each transaction — the buyer sends crypto from any wallet, anywhere in the world. The blockchain confirms the transaction regardless of which country the sender is in. Your Cloudflare Worker receives the webhook and processes the order using the same logic for every buyer.
